evidence.reason: The fixture sets local user.name/email and then commits without disabling commit.gpgSign. Git honors an inherited global commit.gpgSign=true; if no usable signing key is available for the fixture identity, `git commit` fails and DeployFixture.setUp errors before tests run. Setting repository-local `commit.gpgSign=false` before the baseline commit is a routine test-hermeticity fix, not a new requirement.
